description: Use when you have nf-core/rnaseq star_salmon BAMs and a pre-built TE SAF, and need gene + TE subfamily count matrices. Env-locked featureCounts driver: integer Random-One TE counting, row-bound with gene counts. For STAR alignment use star-te-preprocessing. For the TE SAF use te-reference-saf-build. For annotation use annotate-bulk-rnaseq-data.
